g.text: Each service owns its own datastore, consistency model, and failure domain.
relational, ACID -- see schema worked example
precomputed offline, refreshed on a schedule
NO SHARED DATABASE, NO SHARED DEPLOY, NO SHARED FAILURE DOMAIN
A catalog read spike cannot starve the checkout path of capacity -- they don't share a connection pool.
A bad recommendation-model deploy cannot touch order correctness -- it isn't in that transaction.
The gateway is the only thing a client ever sees -- the four-way split behind it is invisible from outside.
